Second, plasma physics techniques from fusion labs have advanced semiconductor manufacturing and thin-film coatings. Third, materials science breakthroughs for reactor shielding have led to better radiation protection in medical and industrial settings. The iritic nature of these cross-disciplinary innovations shows how fundamental research creates unexpected societal value. Furthermore, computational fluid dynamics tools built for fusion modeling now optimize weather forecasting and aerospace engineering, demonstrating the broad reach of fusion-driven scientific progress.
